{{Wireless adapter |brand=CyberTAN |model=UW600-E |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=09/04/2003 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Female B |form_factor=corded (modular) adapter |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=N89-UW600E |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Envara |chip1_model=EN202A |chip2_brand=Envara |chip2_model=EN303B2 |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=abg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "WUSB G V01" and the '''Envara''' logo is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
The FCC photos show the device with a '''Linksys WUSB54G'''-like casing, :however, no marketed Linksys devices have used an '''Envara''' chipset.
The internal photows also show the device with an EN303 RF chip.. :which is the dual-band RF chip (EN313 is 2.4GHz only).
